annotationNote.en: Kohli was bowled on the free hit, so he was not out: the ball stayed live and 3 byes were run.
annotationNote.hinglish: Kohli free hit par bowled hue, isliye out nahi: ball live rahi aur 3 byes daude gaye.
annotationNote.hi: कोहली फ्री हिट पर बोल्ड हुए, इसलिए आउट नहीं: गेंद लाइव रही और 3 बाई दौड़ी गईं।
annotationNote.gu: કોહલી ફ્રી હિટ પર બોલ્ડ થયા, એટલે આઉટ નહીં: બોલ લાઇવ રહ્યો અને 3 બાય દોડાયા.
